title: 第八章讲道蓬莱、机缘突破
slug: 洪荒无量道全本免费-洪荒无量道最新章节列表
content_zh:
蓬莱岛中心，一座庄严的道宫坐落于此，道宫前的道场上，一个面容平凡，青衣青年，盘坐在一蒲团上，正在专心讲道，岛上的大道之音就是从这里传出的。这个人自然就是玄元道尊了，在建成自己的道场之后，又看到岛上的其他生灵，灵光一闪，不由动了讲道的念头。如今的岛上生灵，几乎都没有开启灵智，一副懵懂的样子，更不要说修炼了。
“既然是生在这里，也算是有缘了，何不为他们讲道一番，或许可帮助他们，也是一场功德了。以后道场之中也要有人打理，从中选出也不错。”思及此处，玄元也就开始了讲道，如今已经是第三次了，每次讲道一千年，从凡境讲到金仙，效果也是不错，大部分都能开启了灵智。“今三次讲道完毕，今后也不会在讲，尔等散去吧！”台下数万生灵均拜服在地，恳请玄元为他们讲道，但是玄元心意已决，他们也无可奈何，只能对着台上拜了拜，就四下散去了。
讲道完毕，玄元起身向着自己当初闭关的山谷走去，来到一山崖处，只见一根青竹扎根于石缝中，婷婷而立，任由风吹雨打也傲然绝立，当玄元靠近，竹枝摇晃向着玄元打招呼，“小竹子倒是有大毅力，若是能够化形，我自把你收入门下，传你本门大道。”轻轻一笑，玄元随口说道，哗啦哗啦，枝条摇晃得更加剧烈了，显示着青竹此刻激动的心情。
这根青竹乃是一普通灵根，连先天灵根都算不上，生长在这一山崖上，当玄元发现她时，其正在顶着狂风，傲然挺立，令玄元不由想到了后世对描写竹子的一首诗，“咬定青山不放松，立根原在破崖中。千磨万击还坚韧，任尔东西南北风。”可以说是对玄元的感触很大，因此，玄元一看到这根青竹，就十分喜爱，按照玄元的看法，在灵植类中，最适合修道的有三种，即竹、梅、松，其毅力之强令人动容，也是道心最坚定的，既然也生长在这里，说明也是缘分，令玄元不由得有了把她收入门下的想法，讲道也大部分是受她所感。
“不过你也得快点化形才行，不然我一个人也怪寂寞的，有个人说话也好。”感叹一声，玄元突然想到自己来此已有十数万年了，自始至终都是一个人，眼中落寞之色闪过，但也很快隐去，似乎感觉到了玄元的内心，青竹摇曳拂过脸庞，似是孩子向大人撒娇般，令得玄元的抑郁之心散去，看向青竹的目光也更加柔和了几分。还想在说些什么，突然玄元好似明悟到了什么，脸色一僵，接着又变得狂喜，一闪身离开了原地，再出现时已回到道宫中。
原来就在玄元内心发生变化，元神一震，却是触摸到了境界的屏障，临近了突破的边缘。玄元道尊讲道完毕，机缘触到了金仙的屏障，知道自己机缘到了，于是一步回到殿中，关闭道宫，打算闭关突破到金仙境界。金仙境界有一前提，那就是心灵通透，使得向道之心坚定，而玄元通过三千年的讲道，梳理了过去所悟，境界更是扎实，面对青竹时又真情流露，让自己认清自我，心灵自在，自是到了突破的锲机。
时间飞逝，密室之中，玄元盘坐于十二品造化青莲上，双目紧闭，心神沉静，以期突破。玄元头顶处，庆云出现，瑞相纷呈。庆云中心，三个虚幻的花苞呈三才之势运转，若隐若现，这便是顶上三花了，只要凝聚而出，便可达到金仙，寿元无限，不朽不灭。“有道成，万物生，凝精气神，造化吾身，三花尽显，成就金仙，金仙之境，给我破。”元神一震。
伴随着一声道喝，天地俱震，岛上灵气瞬间爆发，无数灵气向玄元涌来，形成一个恐怖的灵气漩涡。造化青莲泛出幽幽绿光，缓缓旋转，丝丝造化之气溢出，帮助玄元突破。随着无量能量没入庆云三花中，供给三花吸取，不一会儿，灵气停止，三花凝实，玄妙的道韵流转，尽显玄奥。“哈哈哈，终于突破了，这就是金仙境界吗，果然强大无比，比之玄仙不知强大了多少倍。”金仙领悟法则，出手更是法则相随，威能无比，感受着全身暴涨的实力，玄元心情十分愉悦，更是充满了万丈豪情。

content_en:
In the center of Penglai Island, a solemn Taoist palace is located here. On the dojo in front of the Taoist palace, a young man with an ordinary face in Tsing Yi is sitting cross-legged on a futon and is concentrating on preaching. The sound of the Taoist temple on the island comes from here. This person was naturally Taoist Xuanyuan. After building his own dojo, he saw other creatures on the island and had a flash of inspiration, and he couldn't help but think of preaching. Almost none of the creatures on the island today have opened their spiritual intelligence and look ignorant, let alone practicing.
"Since I was born here, I am destined, why not give a sermon for them, maybe I can help them, it is also a meritorious deed. In the future, there will be someone to take care of the dojo, and it would be good to choose from them." Thinking of this, Xuanyuan began to preach. Now it is the third time. Each sermon lasts for a thousand years, from the mortal realm to the golden immortal. The effect is also good, most of them can open up spiritual wisdom. "The three sermons have been completed today and will not be preached again in the future. Please disperse!" Tens of thousands of people in the audience bowed to the ground and begged Xuanyuan to preach for them. However, Xuanyuan had made up his mind and they had no choice but to bow to the stage and disperse.
After the sermon, Xuanyuan got up and walked towards the valley where he had retreated. When he came to a mountain cliff, he saw a green bamboo rooted in the crack of the stone, standing proudly despite the wind and rain. When Xuanyuan approached, the bamboo branch swayed and greeted Xuanyuan. , "Little Bamboo has a lot of perseverance. If you can transform, I will take you under my sect and teach you the way of my sect." With a slight smile, Xuanyuan said casually, and the branches shook more violently, showing Qingzhu's excitement at this moment.
This green bamboo is an ordinary spiritual root, not even an innate spiritual root. It grows on this cliff. When Xuanyuan found her, it was standing proudly against the strong wind. Xuanyuan couldn't help but think of a poem describing bamboo in later generations, "Stick to the green mountain and don't let go. The root is in the broken cliff. It has been tough after thousands of blows, regardless of the east, west, north, and south winds." It can be said that Xuanyuan was very touched. Therefore, when Xuanyuan saw this green bamboo, he loved it very much. According to Xuanyuan's opinion, among the spiritual plants, there are three types that are most suitable for practicing Taoism, namely bamboo, plum, and pine. Their perseverance is touching, and they are also the ones with the strongest Taoist heart. Since they also grow here, it means it is fate. Xuanyuan couldn't help but have the idea of taking her into his sect, and most of his sermons were inspired by her.
"But you have to transform quickly, otherwise I will feel lonely all by myself. It's good to have someone to talk to." Xuan Yuan sighed, and suddenly thought that he had been here for tens of thousands of years, and he was alone the whole time, with lonely eyes. The color flashed, but soon disappeared, as if he felt Xuanyuan's heart, the green bamboo swayed across his face, like a child acting coquettishly to an adult, which made Xuanyuan's depressed heart dissipate, and his eyes looking at Qingzhu became a little softer. He was still about to say something, but suddenly Xuan Yuan seemed to realize something. His face froze, and then he became ecstatic. He left the place in a flash, and when he reappeared, he had returned to the Taoist palace.
It turned out that there was a change in Xuanyuan's heart, and his soul was shocked, but he touched the barrier of the realm and was close to the edge of breakthrough. After Taoist Master Xuanyuan finished his sermon, he accidentally touched the barrier of the Golden Immortal. He knew that his opportunity had arrived, so he returned to the palace, closed the Taoist Palace, and planned to retreat to the Golden Immortal realm. There is a prerequisite for the Golden Immortal realm, which is that the mind is transparent, which makes the heart for the Tao firm. However, Xuanyuan has sorted out what he has learned in the past through three thousand years of preaching, and his realm is even more solid. When facing Qingzhu, he reveals his true feelings, allowing himself to recognize himself clearly and feel at ease. This is the moment for breakthrough.
Time flies, and in the secret room, Xuanyuan sits cross-legged on the twelfth-grade creation green lotus, with his eyes closed and his mind calm, hoping for a breakthrough. At the top of Xuanyuan's head, Qingyun appeared, showing various auspicious signs. In the center of Qingyun, three illusory flower buds appear like three talents.Rotating, looming, these are the three flowers on the top. As long as they are condensed, they can reach the golden immortality, have unlimited lifespan, and be immortal. "When the Tao is achieved, all things come into being. I condense my energy and spirit to create my body. The three flowers are fully displayed and I become a golden immortal. The realm of golden immortal can be broken by me." Yuan Shen was shocked.
With a shout, the heaven and earth shook, and the spiritual energy on the island exploded instantly. Countless spiritual energy surged toward Xuanyuan, forming a terrifying spiritual energy vortex. The Green Lotus of Creation glowed with a faint green light, slowly rotating, and traces of the Qi of Creation overflowed, helping Xuanyuan break through. As the immeasurable energy poured into the three flowers of Qingyun, it was supplied to the three flowers for absorption. After a while, the spiritual energy stopped, the three flowers solidified, and the mysterious Taoist rhyme circulated, showing the mystery. "Hahaha, I finally broke through. Is this the Golden Immortal realm? It is indeed extremely powerful. I don't know how many times more powerful than the Xuan Immortal." The Golden Immortal understood the law, and the law followed him when he took action. It was extremely powerful. Feeling the soaring strength in his body, Xuanyuan was in a very happy mood, and he was full of pride.
